text: …　そうね　おとこのこは　いつか　たびに　でるもの　なのよ　うん…　テレビの　はなしよ！

structure.jp: おとこのこは　いつか　たびに　でるもの　なのよ
structure.en: boys are the kind to leave on a journey someday

structure.jp: テレビの　はなしよ！

patterns.name: 〜ものだ
patterns.explanation: もの after a verb says 'that is just how things naturally are'. でるもの　なのよ = 'it is simply the way of things that they leave'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives the feel of explaining something; ending with なのよ instead of なのだ sounds soft and womanly. でるもの　なのよ = 'you see, they do leave'.
